name: Sicktrace!
source:
Follow the story of a male protagonist who leaves his small town behind to start fresh at college, navigating a world of unfamiliar experiences and relationships.
Your choices will shape his journey, influencing friendships and romantic encounters along the way.
translation:
跟随一位男主角的故事，他离开自己的小镇，开始上大学，在一个充满陌生经历和人际关系的世界中航行。
你的选择将塑造他的旅程，影响一路上的友谊和浪漫遭遇。
